consumer: The engine mission-completion predicate mission::is_complete (the same value the NPC turn-in/dialogue eligibility consumes), asking 'is the courier find-item goal satisfied right now?' — the engine EVALUATES a yes/no it computes, it does not merely show it
scope: items reachable for the goal: the player's crafting_inventory (carried PLUS nearby/adjacent reachable items), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — queries u.crafting_inventory() and returns tmp_inv.has_amount(item_id,item_count) with a charges fallback, so completion is computed over the crafting-reachable inventory, not a raw carried dump
divergence: The required delivery item lies on an adjacent/nearby tile within crafting reach but is NOT wielded/worn/in inventory: the engine's is_complete returns true (ready to hand in) while a carried-items-only proxy (Excerpt 2 write_carried_items) reports 'not ready' — exposing the carried-only reach as the wrong authority
